alerts.name: OpenRouter error rate
alerts.description: Reasoning, repair or chat calls fail above normal retry noise.
alerts.smoke: In staging, force a mock failed usage event and verify the dashboard query crosses the 15m threshold.

alerts.name: Apify profile fetch error rate
alerts.description: Instagram profile fetch provider failures exceed the accepted launch threshold.
alerts.smoke: In staging, run an analysis against a fixture provider error and confirm Sentry/usage event visibility.

alerts.name: FaceCheck photo search error rate
alerts.description: Photo search provider failures exceed the accepted threshold when the feature is enabled.
alerts.smoke: With FEATURE_PHOTO_SEARCH enabled in staging, run one mock failed search and verify the alert query.

alerts.name: Failed payment events
alerts.description: Webhook processing failures require immediate payment ledger triage.
alerts.smoke: In staging, replay a malformed YooKassa fixture and verify payment_events.processingStatus='failed'.

alerts.name: Aged pending payment orders
alerts.description: Pending orders are older than the expected webhook/expiration window.

source.query: payment_orders where status='pending_payment' and createdAt older than threshold

alerts.smoke: Create a staging pending order, backdate it in a test database, and confirm the query result is non-zero.

alerts.name: Analysis queue backlog
alerts.description: Queued/retrying analysis jobs exceed expected worker capacity.

source.query: analysis_jobs where status in queued/retrying and queueNextRunAt <= now

alerts.smoke: Pause the staging worker, enqueue synthetic analysis jobs, and verify backlog query growth.

alerts.name: Photo search queue backlog
alerts.description: Photo search jobs are waiting beyond expected worker capacity.

source.query: photo_search_jobs where status in queued/retrying and queueNextRunAt <= now

alerts.smoke: Pause the staging worker, enqueue synthetic photo search jobs, and verify backlog query growth.

alerts.name: Stale queue leases
alerts.description: Analysis or photo-search jobs are locked past queueLockedUntil.

source.query: analysis_jobs/photo_search_jobs where queueLockedUntil < now and active status

alerts.smoke: In staging, create one expired locked job and confirm the stale lease query returns it.

alerts.name: Report generation failure rate
alerts.description: Final analysis jobs fail or reports are not produced after paid work.

source.query: analysis_jobs where status='failed' or reports missing for finished jobs

alerts.smoke: Run a staging analysis with a forced report builder failure and verify job/report state is queryable.

alerts.name: Retention worker failures
alerts.description: Retention cleanup loop fails and could leave expired report/payment artifacts behind.
alerts.smoke: Run staging retention with a blocked storage delete and verify a structured error log is emitted.

alerts.name: S3 artifact upload failures
alerts.description: Report artifacts cannot be uploaded or presigned for users.

source.query: S3 upload or presign exceptions from report artifact code

alerts.smoke: Use staging storage credentials with a denied write policy and verify Sentry captures the upload failure.

alerts.name: PDF render failures
alerts.description: PDF export fails or exceeds the configured render timeout.

source.query: pdf render failure or PDF_RENDER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS exceeded

alerts.smoke: Render a staging oversized report fixture and verify timeout/failure telemetry is visible.

alerts.name: Analysis repair rate high
alerts.description: Grounding or report-quality repair is triggered too often, indicating prompt/provider drift.
alerts.smoke: Run the golden eval in staging and confirm repair telemetry is visible in logs/eval output.

alerts.name: Finance cost anomaly
alerts.description: Actual provider costs exceed modeled economics thresholds in finance reconciliation.

source.query: finance:reconciliation anomalies where code in provider_cost_ratio_high or actual_cost_over_model

alerts.smoke: Run finance:reconciliation against a staging fixture with high api_usage_events cost and verify anomaly count.
